name: Ease – Natural Hair Regrowth & Nourishment Oil | Strengthens Roots & Reduces Hair Fall (120ml)
description:
Revive your hair naturally with Hair Ease – Regrowth Formula (120ml), a premium blend of Argan, Rosemary, Castor, Coconut, and Almond Oils enriched with Vitamin E and essential oils. This chemical-free formula deeply nourishes the scalp, strengthens hair roots, and promotes natural hair regrowth. Perfect for those facing hair fall, dandruff, or thinning hair — Hair Ease restores strength, shine, and volume while maintaining long-term scalp health.
Key Features:
 Stimulates natural hair regrowth and strengthens roots
 Reduces hair fall, breakage, and split ends
 Deeply nourishes scalp for healthy hair growth
 Adds shine, smoothness, and volume
 Helps control dandruff and dryness
 Free from sulfates, parabens, and harsh chemicals
 Suitable for all hair types — men and women
How to Use:
 Apply directly to scalp and massage gently for 10 minutes
 Leave on for at least 30 minutes or overnight for deeper absorption
 Wash with mild shampoo
 Use 2–3 times weekly for best results
Key Ingredients & Benefits:
 Argan Oil: Moisturizes and restores shine
 Rosemary Oil: Strengthens roots and boosts growth
 Castor Oil: Thickens and nourishes hair
 Coconut Oil: Prevents protein loss and breakage
 Almond Oil: Softens and smooths
 Vitamin E: Repairs and protects hair from damage
 Tea Tree & Peppermint Oils: Keep scalp clean and stimulate circulation
 Lavender & Cedarwood Oils: Reduce stress-related hair fall
 Thyme & Grape Seed Extracts: Support density and lock in moisture
Package Includes:
 1 × Hair Ease Regrowth & Nourishment Oil (120ml)
